Name: Mondelez International Inc
Description: Mondelez International, Inc. is a leading American multinational company specializing in snacks, confectionery, and beverages, headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. With a diverse portfolio of well-known brands such as Oreo, Cadbury, and Trident, Mondelez operates in over 150 countries, focusing on innovation and sustainability to drive growth in the snack food industry. The company capitalizes on trends in consumer preferences by offering a blend of indulgent and healthier options, strengthening its position as a global leader in the market while delivering solid financial performance and shareholder value.
Address: 905 WEST FULTON MARKET, CHICAGO, IL, UNITED STATES, 60607
